rows: 5 years, entered straight after Class 12 CLAT (for the 26 participating National Law Universities) or individual entrance tests/CUET for other 5-year law schools

CLAT 2026 offered roughly 4,092 undergraduate seats across the 26 NLUs, against tens of thousands of aspirants nationwide. It is a genuine national-level filter, and it front-loads legal training with two to three years of a humanities/social-science degree, which is why NLU graduates are the group most actively recruited by top firms, the judiciary track, and large in-house teams.

items.heading: A Litigator, a Corporate Transactional
items.text: A litigator, a corporate transactional associate, a compliance officer, a judge, and a law professor all hold the same base credential and do almost entirely different jobs.

items.heading: Pay Ranges Across These Branches
items.text: Pay ranges across these branches do not overlap much at entry level: a first-year litigation junior and a first-year Tier-1 firm associate can be earning ten to fifteen times apart.

items.heading: Regulation Is Reshaping the Field
items.text: Regulation is reshaping the field mid-career for current students, the judiciary's 2025 practice-first rule and the Bar Council's still-developing AI-conduct rules both changed the ground rules in the last two years.

items.heading: Unlike Medicine or Ca, There
items.text: Unlike medicine or CA, there is no single unifying licensing exam step at the very start; AIBE and state bar enrolment matter for practice, but several branches, in-house, LPO, policy, academia, do not strictly require them at all.
